### <u>Bi-Weekly Report</u>

- **VLCC market comes to life amid Lunar New Year rush and heightened geopolitical tensions -** Following an uneventful conclusion to January loadings, the **VLCC** (Very Large Crude Carrier) market displayed **stronger indications** across global regions in the second week of February as Charterers rushed to secure shipments **ahead of the Lunar New Year**, prompting a resurgence in rates. With a reduction in tonnage supply, particularly for earlier cargoes, owners found themselves in a favorable position to capitalize on the tighter conditions.
